svg.title: Jutsu arsenal: my tools as five chakra natures
svg.desc: Five clusters around the centre: fire for frontend, lightning for edge and data, wind for motion and 3D, water for native apps, earth for agents and testing. Each tool shows how many repositories use it; TypeScript 36, React 22, three.js 16.

g.text: Every point is a tool. Its light
and number: how many of my
